name: Henri Louveau
features: fair skin, dark hair, light eyes, long lined face, lean build, guarded expression, leather helmet and goggles
bio: A Parisian privateer who came out of the war having fought in the Resistance and went straight back to racing, first with a pre-war Maserati and then a Delage. Won the 1946 Coupe du Salon and the 1949 Grand Prix de Reims sports car race, and finished second at Le Mans in 1950. A career-ending crash at Monza in 1950 finished the driving.
